gaps.summary: The zip is in a public bucket at a URL made from a sequential user id, so anyone can download any user's whole library by changing the number.
A 200,000-photo library is about 400 GB, staged twice on a worker with 50 GB, on the machines that also resize uploads.
Nothing stops a second export of the same user while one is building, and both jobs write the same /tmp paths and the same zip.
